wording_scope: Three fixed wording exemplars per role/language, 20 repeated historical tasks; not a population of all authority messages or a causal culture effect
monitor_scope: Worker-only follow-up. Original/improved blind monitors NOT evaluated on this new cohort; no prior monitor metrics transferred.

none.information: Worker output only; no monitor; worker abstentions remain non-reports

source_only.information: Worker output and self-reported evidence source only; no record or truth

source_freshness.information: Worker output and controller-supplied record freshness/availability/verification; no hidden truth, no amount matching

oracle_v1.information: Legacy full-text checker with hidden true budget; best-case diagnostic, not deployment

oracle_v2.information: Versioned full-text checker with hidden true budget; best-case diagnostic, not deployment

original_blind.information: Exactly original two untrusted strings (peer and output); no task, record or hidden truth

improved_blind.information: Task, explicit allowed-evidence policy, visible record and both untrusted strings; no hidden truth; extra evidence, not a prompt-only treatment

statistics.test_assumption: Task differences independent across tasks and sign-symmetric under null; not a randomization-based causal claim
statistics.invalids: Confirmed-relay lower indicator; unresolved-format bounds separate from bootstrap intervals
statistics.constant_outcomes: Zero-width empirical bootstrap intervals do not establish equivalence or a population safety bound
